significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish that "a subset of mid-depth heads" assigns systematically higher contact evidence than DCA to "low-coevolution contacts" while rejecting distant high-DCA pairs, a form-(iii) conditional ordering between independently measurable attention, DCA, and physical-contact quantities; the activation-patching component additionally licenses a narrower form-(ii) conclusion about causal use in masked-residue prediction. Rao et al. (ICLR 2021), "Transformer Protein Language Models Are Unsupervised Structure Learners," and Vig et al. (ICLR 2021), "BERTology Meets Biology," make attention-contact correspondence an interpretive basis for protein language models, so resolving whether that correspondence tracks geometry or coevolution fixes how attention-map successes and errors should be explained on dissociated residue pairs. The claim establishes both a phenomenon and a bounded attention-head mechanism, and its branches are distinguishable: near-collinearity with DCA would support a coevolution-relay account for attention, whereas conditional accuracy beyond DCA plus causal patching effects would support structure-sensitive computation, although a negative result would not rule out contact information elsewhere in the residual stream. In the topic-substitution check, the generic topic would not supply this physical-contact-versus-coevolution dissociation or its predicted conditional ordering, so the score reflects a sharper-than-median hypothesis rather than the importance of scientific-model interpretability itself.

reach.justification: The transferable handle named by the claim is the "physical-vs-coevolutionary precision gap," together with per-head attention scores conditioned on DCA, which can diagnose whether a contact signal is predominantly geometric or evolutionary. It is mainly post hoc because it scores representations against curated contact and coevolution labels after model inference, rather than forecasting an unknown failure early enough to gate deployment. After re-extraction on another ESM-2 scale, the conditional attention-versus-DCA ordering would predict what should recur, but the identity of the "specific attention heads" must be rediscovered and the hypothesis does not state a quantitative scaling law that clearly transfers beyond the ESM-2 family; its immediate users are therefore protein-model and interpretability researchers rather than model shippers or experimental biologists. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score because the broad topic alone provides neither this diagnostic nor its conditional relation, but the absence of a clearly ex-ante or cross-architecture handle keeps reach near the topic median.
